callouts.title: 想法
callouts.body: 如果一个$\mathbb{R}$上的实函数$f(x)$可以解析延拓，或者通过某种变换转换为复平面上某个包含实轴的区域$E$上的亚纯函数$F(z)$。于是我们可以考虑使用复分析的工具处理关于函数$F(z)$在$E$内全局的性质，最后再尝试把全局的结果还原到局部的$f(x)$上(实轴上)。

if_strategy_template.summary_en: When a real-valued function on $\mathbb{R}$ admits an analytic continuation, or can be transformed into a meromorphic function on a complex domain containing the real axis, study the global complex-analytic properties first. Then transfer the resulting global conclusions back to the original real-variable problem on the real axis.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a real-variable problem can be embedded into complex analysis through analytic continuation or a change of variables.

callouts.title: 基本的想法
callouts.body: 当我们遇到一个不好直接处理的实积分(特别是涉及无穷区间上的积分)时，我们发现被积分的实函数$f(x)$在复平面上与一个亚纯函数$F(z)$有着密切的关系。那么我们可以考虑函数在一个包含实数轴的区域上亚纯函数$F(z)$的性质，把涉及的实积分视为亚纯函数在区域边界上的积分的一部分，然后利用留数定理，建立起实积分与留数之间的关系。

if_strategy_template.summary_en: For difficult real integrals, especially over unbounded intervals, relate the integrand to a meromorphic function on a complex domain containing the real axis. View the real integral as part of a contour integral and use the residue theorem to connect it with residues.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies to real integrals whose integrands extend naturally to meromorphic functions and can be handled by contour integration.

callouts.title: 可延拓为带状区域上满足衰减条件的全纯函数的实函数
callouts.body:
$f\in \mathscr{S}$,指的是存在某个正实数$a$使得$f \in \mathscr{S}_a$满足:
1. 函数$f$可以解析延拓为在带状区域$S_a:=\{z\in \mathbb{C}:|\text{Im}(z)|<a\}$上全纯的函数$f(z)$。
2. $f(z)$满足衰减的条件:$$|f(x+iy)|\lesssim_{b,f} \frac{1}{1+|x|^{\alpha}}$$其中$\alpha>1$,$|y|\leq b<a$

classification_result.english_title: Real Functions Extendable to Holomorphic Functions on a Strip with Decay Conditions

callouts.title: 函数傅里叶变换呈现指数衰减
callouts.body: 如果函数$f \in \mathscr{F}_a$那么对于任意的$0<b<a$其傅里叶变换都满足$$\widehat{f}(\xi)\lesssim_{b,f,\alpha}e^{-2\pi b|\xi|}$$对任意$\xi \in \mathbb{R}$成立。

classification_result.english_title: The Fourier Transform Exhibits Exponential Decay

if_problem.statement_en: If $f \in \mathscr{F}_a$, then for every $0<b<a$, its Fourier transform satisfies $$\widehat{f}(\xi)\lesssim_{b,f,\alpha}e^{-2\pi b|\xi|}$$ for all $\xi \in \mathbb{R}$.

callouts.title: 基本原理:
callouts.body: 假设函数$f \in L^1(\mathbb{R})$，那么这个函数衰减地越快，其傅里叶变换$\widehat{f}$就会越正规。

callouts.title: 问题2.1
callouts.body: 如果我有一个实函数$f\in L^1(\mathbb{R})$，其傅里叶变换$\widehat{f}$满足和上面一样的快速衰减的条件$$\widehat{f}(\xi)\lesssim_{b,f}e^{-2\pi a|\xi|}$$是不是说这个函数一定可以拓展为复平面上的带状区域$S_a$上的一个全纯函数了？

if_problem.statement_en: Suppose $f\in L^1(\mathbb{R})$ is a real function whose Fourier transform satisfies the same rapid decay condition as above, namely $$\widehat{f}(\xi)\lesssim_{b,f}e^{-2\pi a|\xi|}.$$ Must it follow that $f$ extends to a holomorphic function on the strip $S_a$ in the complex plane?

callouts.title: 平移公式
callouts.body: 如果$f \in \mathscr{F}_a$那么对于任意的带状区域当中的复数$\omega \in S_a$函数$x\mapsto f(x-\omega)$的傅里叶变换为$$\xi\mapsto e^{-2\pi i \xi \omega }\widehat{f}(\xi)$$

if_problem.statement_en: If $f \in \mathscr{F}_a$, then for any complex number $\omega \in S_a$, the Fourier transform of the function $x\mapsto f(x-\omega)$ is $$\xi\mapsto e^{-2\pi i \xi \omega }\widehat{f}(\xi).$$
key_techniques: translation property of the Fourier transform

callouts.title: 当前版本下的傅里叶逆变换公式

classification_result.english_title: Fourier Inversion Formula in the Present Convention

callouts.title: Perron公式
callouts.body: $f:\mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{C}$是一个亚多项式增长的函数，也就是说满足$f(n)\lesssim_{\varepsilon,f} n^{\varepsilon}$对任意自然数$n$以及$\varepsilon>0$。令$F(s)$表示在右半平面$\{\text{Re}(s)>1\}$上的Dirichlet级数$$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{f(s)}{n^s}$$那么对于任意非整数的正实数$x$，以及$\sigma>1$成立公式$$\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)=\frac{1}{2\pi i }\lim_{T\to \infty}\int_{\sigma-iT}^{\sigma+iT}F(s)\frac{x^s}{s}\,ds$$

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f:\mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{C}$ be a function of subpolynomial growth, meaning that $f(n)\lesssim_{\varepsilon,f} n^{\varepsilon}$ for every natural number $n$ and every $\varepsilon>0$. Let $F(s)$ denote the Dirichlet series on the half-plane $\{\operatorname{Re}(s)>1\}$ given by $$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{f(n)}{n^s}.$$ Then for every positive non-integer real number $x$ and every $\sigma>1$, one has $$\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)=\frac{1}{2\pi i }\lim_{T\to \infty}\int_{\sigma-iT}^{\sigma+iT}F(s)\frac{x^s}{s}\,ds.$$
